\noindent   \textbf{Question 1 (Compulsory).} Answer in brief of the following:

\begin{parts}
  \item Define a saddle point in game theory. \pts{2}
  \item Define Operations Research (O.R.). \pts{2}
  \item In which way does a transportation problem differ from an assignment problem? \pts{2}
  \item Define Reliability in reliability engineering. \pts{2}
  \item Who is known as the father of game theory? \pts{2}
  \item Who developed the transportation problem? \pts{2}
  \item Define a parallel system with a suitable example. \pts{2}
  \item For which probability distribution is the hazard rate constant? \pts{2}
  \item Define non-degenerate feasible solution in linear programming. \pts{2}
  \item Write the dual of the following Linear Programming Problem (LPP):
  
\begin{align*}
     \text{Minimize } & Z = 15x_1 + 10x_2 \\
     \text{subject to: } & 5x_1 + 3x_2 \ge 5 \\
    & x_1 + 5x_2 \ge 12 \\
    & x_1, x_2 \ge 0
  \end{align*} \pts{2} 2.
Explain how and why Operations Research (O.R.) methods are valuable in aiding executive decision making. Discuss the phases of an O.R. study. \pts{12.5}
\medskip\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt} 3.
Solve the following Linear Programming Problem (LPP) using the Simplex method:

\begin{align*}
   \text{Minimize } & Z = x_1 - 3x_2 + 2x_3 \\
   \text{subject to: } & 3x_1 - x_2 + 2x_3 \le 7 \\
  & -2x_1 + 4x_2 \le 12 \\
  & -4x_1 + 3x_2 + 8x_3 \le 10 \\
  & x_1, x_2, x_3 \ge 0
\end{align*} \pts{12.5}
